g.text: Winnie the Agent: data flow and trust boundaries
Attackers reach an SSH honeypot and a set of protocol traps, which only write events. Once an hour a separate agents container reads the event log,
triages, responds, writes a digest, tunes the bait, drafts detections and, if enabled, exports events. Anything that acts outside the honeypot waits for the operator.
Fixed facts: front-ends SSH, SIP, FTP, Telnet, SMTP, HTTP, S3, Redis, PostgreSQL, MySQL, MSSQL, HL7 | events as JSON lines | agents run hourly (python -m agents run-all) | detections drafted as Sigma
10 Ship exports new lines to S3
